summary: Frontend-only Playwright validation (390x844) of the wavy-note / liveStars fix in game.tsx. ALL 5 in-scope flows PASS. (1) NO CRASH entering gameplay: Home → quick-play-button → analysis (auto-build finishes in ~1s) → play-generated-chart-button → gameplay-screen mounts cleanly with zero non-CORS JS errors and no ReferenceError for `liveStars`. Body snippet during countdown confirms accuracy row text '100.0%' preceded by 5 star glyphs (\uf595). (2) LIVE 5-STAR HUD RENDERS: 5 Ionicons star-outline icons render in the accuracy row of the top HUD, positioned between the accuracy progress bar and the accuracy % text (see artifacts_iter4/08_gameplay_countdown.jpeg and 09_gameplay_playing.jpeg). liveStars variable + styles.liveStars are both defined (game.tsx:391, styles.liveStars at :464). (3) LANE PADS: lane-1..4-hit-pad testIDs are wired inside settings.showLanePads (game.tsx:442) and the 4 colored pads render at the bottom (visible in screenshots). Tapping at pad coordinates triggers laneFlash animations (pink lane visibly flashed in 10_after_taps.jpeg after coordinate taps). (4) DRAG ACROSS LANES DOES NOT CRASH: horizontal mouse-drag from x=20→380 across the pads container completes without exception; gameplay-screen still mounted immediately after; pink lane visibly flashed during traversal (11_after_drag.jpeg). This exercises the new onPadsTouchMove + onMoveShouldSetResponder handlers. (5) PAUSE FLOW: pause-game-button opens the modal with resume/restart/exit buttons (12_pause_modal.jpeg); Resume closes modal and gameplay resumes; Restart resets state and gameplay-screen re-renders; Exit navigates to /library. Precise wavy-note timed tracing was not verified (device-only / non-deterministic in web preview), matching the review request note.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still emits 'shadow*' → boxShadow, 'textShadow*' → textShadow, and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents deprecation warnings. Also 'useNativeDriver is not supported' warnings. All non-blocking, previously reported in iteration_2/3.
Fetches to https://treesh.app/content/songs and CORS proxies fail on the web preview. Does not affect gameplay flows (falls back to bundled songs). Reference: /app/frontend/src/game/AppState.tsx

critical_code_review_comments: game.tsx:391 — liveStars derivation is correct (5-tier accuracy → 0..5) and referenced only in the accRow render at :427.
game.tsx:464 — styles.liveStars is defined ({flexDirection:'row', alignItems:'center', gap:1}). Was previously undefined, which was the reported crash root cause. Fix verified.
game.tsx:441 — pads View correctly uses onStartShouldSetResponder + onMoveShouldSetResponder + onTouchStart/Move/End/Cancel, giving the responder system permission to receive drag moves.
game.tsx:370 — onPadsTouchMove reads locationX/pageX, clamps lane to 0..3, and diff-updates `pressed` set (delete prev, add new) + calls flashLane on lane change. Correct.

game.tsx:57 — wavyLaneAt(note, t) correctly derives the required lane from note.path over time (frac clamped 0..1, index rounded, lane clamped 0..3), enabling the sustain effect (game.tsx:337) to demand the follower's lane track the wave. Fallback to note.lane when no path is present.
chartEngine cross-lane wavePath attachment could not be re-verified here (out of scope for the crash-focused UI test) but the wavy sustain logic in game.tsx correctly consumes note.path when present.
